dataset: Building Permits - Cleared Permits (resources: Cleared Building Permits since 2017; Cleared Permits 2000 to 2016)
license_access: Open Government Licence - Toronto (licence_title on CKAN record; licence text opened at https://open.toronto.ca/open-data-licence/)
temporal_coverage: COMPLETED_DATE 2001-01-01 to 2026 (2000-2016 file: 448,093 rows; since-2017 file: 447,644 rows). No rows have COMPLETED_DATE in calendar 2007. Publisher note: 'Information for applications where APPLICATION_DATE is earlier than Oct 1, 1999 is likely to be incomplete'
key_fields: PERMIT_NUM ('Last two digits of calendar year, plus IBMS-generated sequence'); REVISION_NUM; PERMIT_TYPE; STRUCTURE_TYPE; WORK; STREET_NUM; STREET_NAME; STREET_TYPE; STREET_DIRECTION; POSTAL ('First 3 digits'); GEO_ID ('City-defined, unique identifier for Property Address'); WARD_GRID; APPLICATION_DATE; ISSUED_DATE; COMPLETED_DATE ('Date work is complete and permit is cleared'); STATUS; DESCRIPTION; CURRENT_USE; PROPOSED_USE; DWELLING_UNITS_CREATED; DWELLING_UNITS_LOST; EST_CONST_COST; RESIDENTIAL (sq m); DEMOLITION (sq m); BUILDER_NAME (since-2017 file only)
limitations: No planning-application number. STATUS includes 'Closed' (815,694), 'Cancelled' (62,112) and 'Closed - Dormant' (14,501), so clearance is partly administrative. Units on cleared New Building permits equal 22-62% of CMHC completions each year 2002-2024 (corr 0.23), then surge to 22,359 in 2025 (a batch closure). Only 48% of 50+ unit permits issued 2010-2018 have cleared. DWELLING_UNITS_LOST is non-null for only ~35% of rows; 1 unit record of 100,000 (data error); 11 negative values. The pre-2017 file uses lower-case headers with a timestamp date format.
join_keys: GEO_ID = Address Points ADDRESS_POINT_ID (88.6% of all permits, 69.8% of new-residential permits). Permit-number stem (first two tokens) groups BLD/Bnn/FND/SHO/STR/PLB/HVA/DRN permits into one folder. Address string -> D04/D05/D06.
provenance: opened and verified (CKAN package_show + datastore schema via API; full file downloaded and profiled 2026-10-30)

dataset: Development Applications
license_access: Open Government Licence - Toronto (licence_title on CKAN record; licence text opened at https://open.toronto.ca/open-data-licence/)
geographic_coverage: City of Toronto; one row per application-address (26,648 rows; 8,622 unique APPLICATION#)
temporal_coverage: DATE_SUBMITTED 2008-01-04 to 2026-10-02. Types OZ, SA, SB, PL, CD (no MV/CO). 2,677 unique OZ applications 2008-2025.
key_fields: APPLICATION_TYPE; APPLICATION#; STREET_NUM/NAME/TYPE/DIRECTION; POSTAL; DATE_SUBMITTED; STATUS ('The internal status of the application in the review process'); X; Y ('The NAD27 x coordinate'); DESCRIPTION; REFERENCE_FILE#; FOLDERRSN; WARD_NUMBER; WARD_NAME; COMMUNITY_MEETING_DATE; APPLICATION_URL; PARENT_FOLDER_NUMBER; CONTACT_* (personal planner contacts; do not republish)
limitations: Current status only; no decision, approval or appeal dates. STATUS values include Closed, Under Review, 'OMB Appeal' (697 rows), 'OMB Approved', 'Appeal Received' and 'Council Approved'. Appeal status is overwritten once a file closes: only 0-5% of 2008-2015 OZ files show an appeal status, versus 20-29% of 2020-2025 files. Status strings carry trailing spaces. The coordinate CRS label (NAD27) conflicts with value ranges (X 293,785-647,028); verify the CRS.
join_keys: APPLICATION# = D04 'Application Number' (96.9% match); address -> permits (89-97% of OZ files match some permit address); PARENT_FOLDER_NUMBER links related apps
provenance: opened and verified (CKAN package_show + datastore schema via API; full file downloaded and profiled 2026-10-30)

dataset: Development Pipeline
publisher: City of Toronto - City Planning (Planning Research and Analytics); source Land Use Information System II
license_access: Open Government Licence - Toronto (licence_title on CKAN record; licence text opened at https://open.toronto.ca/open-data-licence/)
geographic_coverage: City of Toronto; 2,391 projects; address + ward (no coordinates - publisher: dataset can be geocoded using its addresses)
temporal_coverage: Rolling five-year window ('projects with activity between January 1, 2021, and December 31, 2025' for the 2025 edition); Date Received 1995-2026
key_fields: 'Pipeline Status' (Under Review 655 / Active 1,089 / Built 647); 'Application Number' (lead application: 1,644 OZ, 744 SA); 'Date Received'; 'Description'; 'Address'; 'Ward'; 'Proposed Residential Gross Floor Area'; 'Proposed Non-Residential Gross Floor Area'; 'Proposed Gross Floor Area'; 'Proposed Residential Units'
limitations: No Built or permit dates, and no permit numbers. 'Active' merges the bulletin's Approved, Permit Application and Permit Issued stages. Excludes as-of-right work and projects under the Site Plan Control threshold ('fewer than 10 units'). Units are proposed, not as built. Open-data total (927,532 units) differs from the 2025 bulletin (>791,000). 'Built' totals 124,326 units vs. 95,701 CMHC completions in the City 2021-2025, so definitions differ. 'Built' means 'Projects that became ready for occupancy and/or were completed'.
join_keys: Application Number -> D03 APPLICATION#; Address -> permits (98% of Built projects match a permit address; 79.5% of residential Built projects match a new-residential permit address)
provenance: opened and verified (CKAN package_show + datastore schema via API; full file downloaded and profiled 2026-10-30); definitions from 2025 bulletin PDF opened

dataset: Zoning By-law (569-2013 GIS layers: Zoning Area + 10 overlays + readme)
license_access: Open Government Licence - Toronto (licence_title on CKAN record; licence text opened at https://open.toronto.ca/open-data-licence/)
geographic_coverage: Lands subject to 569-2013 only (11,719 Zoning Area polygons). Lands still under former by-laws are absent (no ZN_STATUS=5 polygons in the current file).
temporal_coverage: Current snapshot. Description: 'updated to include amendments up to June 18th, 2023'. The legal office consolidation runs further ahead (site-specific amendments to July 31, 2024; city-wide to April 30, 2026).
key_fields: Zoning Area: GEN_ZONE; ZN_ZONE; ZN_HOLDING; HOLDING_ID; FRONTAGE; ZN_AREA; UNITS; DENSITY; COVERAGE; FSI_TOTAL; PRCNT_COMM; PRCNT_RES; PRCNT_EMMP; PRCNT_OFFC; ZN_EXCPTN; EXCPTN_NO; STAND_SET; ZN_STATUS; ZN_STRING; AREA_UNITS; ZBL_CHAPT; ZBL_SECTN; ZBL_EXCPTN. Height Overlay: HT_STORIES; HT_STRING; HT_LABEL (readme says HT_HEIGHT). Lot Coverage: PRCNT_CVER
limitations: Publisher: 'without direct access to the text of the Zoning By-law, the mapped data is meaningless'. 75.5% of polygons have an exception (ZN_EXCPTN=Y); only 48 have a holding symbol. FSI_TOTAL>0 in only 24.1% of polygons and DENSITY>0 in 18.7%. 50.8% of 50+ unit new-building permits (and 12.7% of single-unit ones) geocode outside any 569-2013 polygon. No version history; Wayback Machine holds CKAN copies captured 2023-04-04 and 2024-06-05.
join_keys: Spatial (EPSG:2952) via Address Points; EXCPTN_NO + zone -> Chapter 900 exception text (D08)
provenance: opened and verified (CKAN package_show + datastore schema via API; full file downloaded and profiled 2026-10-30); readme downloaded; spatial join run
